title: Sergeant Linus Mosk
description: A hardened veteran, Sergeant Linus Mosk served in the Corporate Tactical Forces. When he was summoned in the middle of the night by Syril Karn to mete out justice in the investigation of the deaths of two Preox-Morlana employees, he was delighted to be given the mission. When he and Karn botched the entire operation, he was forced to take a job at a smelter, but the fire of justice never left him.
